name: Beth Azmaveth
overview: Beth Azmaveth, also referred to simply as Azmaveth or Bethazmaveth, is identified in Scripture as a town associated with the tribe of Benjamin. The population figures recorded in Ezra 2:24 and Nehemiah 7:28 show a consistent count of forty-two men from this location, underscoring its recognized community within the post-exilic restoration period. Additionally, Nehemiah 12:29 situates Azmaveth among the villages built around Jerusalem for the singers, highlighting its role in the worship life of Israel during the rebuilding of the city.
